items.exampleEn: She has excellent verbal skills, so she does well in interviews.
items.exampleZh: 她的口語表達能力很好，所以面試表現都不錯。

items.exampleEn: The museum has descriptive signs next to each painting.
items.exampleZh: 博物館在每幅畫旁邊都有說明牌。

items.exampleEn: The movie is much shorter than the book version.
items.exampleZh: 電影版比書的版本短很多。

items.exampleEn: The analyst predicted that house prices would fall next year.
items.exampleZh: 那位分析師預測明年房價會下跌。

items.exampleEn: The new rules essentially ban phones in class.
items.exampleZh: 新規定基本上就是禁止在課堂上使用手機。

items.exampleEn: Look up the word in the index at the back of the book.
items.exampleZh: 到書後面的索引查這個字。

items.exampleEn: Chess is a good intellectual exercise for children.
items.exampleZh: 下西洋棋對孩子來說是很好的腦力訓練。

items.exampleEn: Scientists study the smallest particles in the universe.
items.exampleZh: 科學家研究宇宙中最小的粒子。

items.exampleEn: This dog breed is known for traits such as loyalty and calmness.
items.exampleZh: 這個品種的狗以忠誠、沉穩等特質聞名。

items.sentenceEn: Tiny particles of dust can damage the inside of a camera.
items.sentenceZh: 微小的灰塵顆粒可能會損壞相機內部。

items.audioEn: The new version of the software is faster and easier to use.
items.audioZh: 新版本的軟體更快，也更容易使用。
options: It is faster and easier to use
It is more colorful and fun to use

items.sentenceEn: Some people remember verbal instructions better than written ones.
items.sentenceZh: 有些人比較記得住口頭指示，而不是書面指示。

items.sentenceEn: Essentially, the problem is that we don't have enough staff.
items.sentenceZh: 基本上，問題在於我們人手不足。

items.stemEn: Patience and kindness are important ____ for a good teacher.
items.stemZh: 耐心和親切是好老師的重要特質。

items.stemEn: The writer uses very ____ language, so you can almost see the places in the story.
items.stemZh: 作者用了非常有描述性的語言，讓你幾乎能看見故事裡的地方。

items.passageEn: Irene, a data analyst at our company, was asked to write a comprehensive report on customer habits. Her first version was very descriptive, with long paragraphs about each shop. Her manager said it was essentially correct but far too long. In the second version, Irene added an index so that readers could find each shop quickly, and she gave a short verbal summary at the weekly meeting. Her manager praised one trait in particular: she can explain complex data in simple language. Irene enjoys the intellectual challenge of her work, and she hopes to lead her own team one day.
items.passageZh: Irene 是我們公司的資料分析師，她被要求寫一份關於顧客習慣的全面報告。她的第一版寫得非常詳細，每家店都有一大段描述。經理說內容基本上正確，但太長了。在第二版裡，Irene 加了一個索引，讓讀者能很快找到每家店，並在每週會議上做了簡短的口頭摘要。經理特別稱讚她的一項特質：她能用淺白的話解釋複雜的數據。Irene 很享受工作上的腦力挑戰，也希望有一天能帶領自己的團隊。

questions.questionZh: 經理對第一版報告有什麼看法？
options: 數字都算錯了，要全部重寫

questions.questionZh: 經理特別稱讚 Irene 的哪一項特質？
options: 很會用英文寫正式的書信
打字很快，報告總是提早幾天交出
做事非常準時，開會從不遲到
能用白話解釋複雜的數據

items.promptZh: 這份工作基本上就是回覆顧客的電子郵件。
referenceEn: This job is essentially answering customers' emails.
Essentially, this job is about replying to customer emails.
rubricZh: essentially 表示「基本上」（例如 is essentially…、Essentially, …）
「回覆」可寫 answer、reply to 等；時態合理即可

items.promptZh: 好奇心是我女兒最明顯的特質。
referenceEn: Curiosity is my daughter's most obvious trait.
My daughter's most noticeable trait is her curiosity.
rubricZh: trait 指「特質」（例如 her most obvious trait 等）
「最明顯的」用最高級，可寫，例如 most obvious、most noticeable 等
「好奇心」可寫，例如 curiosity、her curiosity 等
